verdict.rationale: The EDD is a government service platform for payroll tax filing, payments, and account management, so offering an official CLI for programmatic or agent-driven use is a fair axis. Nothing in the evidence mentions a CLI: the docs describe only the web e-Services portal. Probes found no llms.txt and no OpenAPI spec, and the transactional portal returned 403 at robots.txt.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
